findings.text: non-blocking: the copy assertions cannot fail against the regression they name. With reckon/serve.py:746's `state = dict(state)` removed, _crew_plan_state still receives an independent deepcopy from file_memo.py:406 because no read_only_region is active, and the `shared` dict the test captured on a first cache miss is a separate object from the stored entry, so the case passes at 454795d too (logs/negative-control-repair.log records '2 failed, 1 passed'). The read-only-region path where the copy is load-bearing is covered only by the manual logs/negative-control-fallback-region.log, not by a test, so removing the copy would redden no gate.
